description: Text templates that compile into plain C# classes at build time. There's no runtime package and no reflection, so your templates work with Native AOT.

Move a Windows / .NET application to AWS by adding one library: analyse blockers, score AWS readiness, and generate a Dockerfile, an AWS CloudFormation template, a deployment script, and a migration report.
Optional OpenTelemetry registration and linked-batch sampling for RequestBatcher.
Adds SteamCMD to a LANCommander server: Steam sign-in profiles, an admin page, and the SteamCMD cmdlets for scripts.

Write a Lab Sync Device Hub driver in .NET: driver protocol v0 over stdio, the device seam, the describe vocabulary and a dependency-free JSON codec. Ship it as its own exe or as a library the engine's driver host runs.
Test a LabSync.Driver.Sdk driver: an in-process protocol harness, the driver as a real child process (exe, or library through the driver host), and its package facts.
Opt-in adapter that mirrors .NET console output into Workes.ConsoleSystem while preserving the original output streams.
Hosts the LANCommander Interposer's network relay on a LANCommander server, so players on different networks can play LAN games together.
